Oneliner

Doped Poly-CO shall remain stable in conditions of Low Earth Orbit, demonstrating its usability in such conditions.
Description
  • Doped Poly-CO that could be a viable alternative to traditional electronic board materials.
  • Lower cost of space hardware
    • GaN and Silicon and other materials can be costly.
    • Big savings over the next few years.
  • If proven space rated, electronic components can become more efficient by using Doped Poly-CO
